content: Work item Comments API remains preview in 7.1 (7.1-preview.4). SDK b5 pins 5.1-preview.3 with no format param, so comment text is HTML. SDK v7.1.0 adds AddWorkItemComment with Format (markdown|html). GetComments pages via continuationToken/$top, returns totalCount, count, nextPage; renderedText via $expand. Comments are separate from System.History.
